title: Senusret III returns from Asia; astronomical college ("Egyptian Belus")
summary: CFAH AP-18: Senusret III returned from war in Asia, founded an astronomical college and reorganised the government, 1577/1576 BC.
description: CFAH AP-18: Senusret III returned from war in Asia, founded an astronomical college and reorganised the government, 1577/1576 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-18: Egyptian Belus: Established Astronomical College 1576 B.C."; CFAH-6 Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #18 (1577/1576)
chronologies.note: CFAH-6 Table 1: "Senusret III returned from war in Asia, founded an astronomical college, and reorganized the government." CFAH-6 Argument 4 §10 dates the decree of oppression (Exod 1) to Senusret III, 1577 BC ("86 years before the Exodus", from the Midrash); that date is not numbered as an anchor point.
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
